title: Project Blades
description: This mod adds loads of different weaponry and ways to craft whatever is needed to the game for said weaponry.
body:
Project Blades



Project Blades is a mod that aims to introduce a wide range of items, weapons, and tools to the game.

The mod itself is supposed to add loads of different tools and features with more unique uses and drawbacks to keep them in balance with the game.



Current Update:

1.0.0, Adds a bunch of new Tool Sets, ores, and recipes to the game. This is a much bigger and needed update and balance


These are the toolsets and other items the mod adds: 



Zalazite Tool Set
Zalazite Chunks
Zalazite Blocks

Adamantium Tool Set
Adamantium Chunks
Adamantium Blocks

Tungsten Tool Set
Tungsten Chunks
Tungsten Blocks

Prismarine Tool Set
Prismarine Blocks

Bronze Tool Set
Bronze Blocks

Steel Tool Set
Steel Blocks

Ruby Tool Set
Ruby Blocks



Corroding Sheets
Corroded Tool Set
Rotten Tool Set

Sulfur
Pale Powder
Flintstones
Furs
Warbits
Metal Powder
Grain
Dust
Glazier
Mortar and Pestle


We hope you enjoy this mod!




If you find any bugs in this mod, please leave a comment or a DM about it to either Me or Korevix.

You are free to use this in your modpacks and YouTube videos as well, for all the content creators out there.
